data.name: Ragdoll Operations
data.detailed_description:
Ragdoll Operations is a fast–paced third-person shooter that mixes tight gunplay with over-the-top ragdoll physics. Every bullet, explosion, and collision can send characters flying, turning each firefight into a chaotic action-comedy scene. Your goal is to complete risky operations, work with your team, and somehow stay on your feet in the middle of the mess.

Precise aiming is important, but learning to control your wobbling, physics-driven soldier is just as crucial. From tight corridor breaches to open-area battles, grenades that scatter enemies across the map, and physics-driven mini scenarios, no two encounters ever play out the same way.

Key Features

  • Physics-driven, active ragdoll character controller

  • Third-person camera with responsive movement and aiming

  • Multiple weapon types: rifles, pistols, shotguns, explosives and more

  • Mission-based structure with replayable scenarios and different difficulty levels

  • Easy to pick up, hard to master arcade-style shooting

  • Stylized visuals and exaggerated ragdoll reactions for a fun, over-the-top atmosphere

Ragdoll Operations aims to blend serious tactical decision-making with ridiculous physics moments, creating a shooter you’ll want to jump back into again and again for “just one more mission.”

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent stylized violence using firearms and explosives.
Human-like characters are shot, blown up, and knocked down with exaggerated ragdoll physics.
Visible stylized blood effects can appear when characters are hit or die, but there is no dismemberment and no realistic gore.
There is no nudity or sexual content.
Players who may be sensitive to depictions of gun violence, blood, or death should take this into account.
